_meta.pocket: West-downtown Toronto corridor: Queen West, Ossington, Dundas West, Kensington/Chinatown, Little Italy, King West/Liberty Village, Parkdale, Roncesvalles, The Junction
_meta.provenance: Compiled 2026-11-05 from each clinic's own website, fee page, or public booking platform profile (Jane, Noterro, Mangomint, Booker, ClinicSense, Setmore). The sandbox for this pass blocked direct fetches of booking platforms and clinic sites (proxy CONNECT 403 on fresha.com and janeapp.com, same as the nails pass), so all sourcing and verification are search-derived (extended web search snapshots of the platforms' and clinics' own pages); per-listing notes say which source each menu came from. Toronto massage booking is Jane-dominated: 13 of 19 listings book on Jane clinic pages, which are public, deep-linkable, and were only used where the URL itself appeared in a search result (never constructed from a guessed slug). Durations for massage are almost always published (30/45/60/90min ladder) and are published figures unless a note says otherwise. Massage prices are frequently quoted plus HST; where a source said '+HST' the pre-HST published number is recorded and the note says so, and where prices are stated HST-inclusive the inclusive number is recorded as published. priceTier derives from the 60min massage price (<=$110 tier 2, $111-140 tier 3, >$140 tier 4), applied to the published figure; proxies (55min or 50min prices where no 60min exists) are flagged per listing. Scope: RMT clinics and massage studios; multidisciplinary physio/chiro/acupuncture clinics only where massage is a core advertised offering with its own service page and published prices; one non-RMT massage studio (TOKI) is included because massage is its core offering with published prices, and its note says it is not RMT. One listing per clinic: Jane books per practitioner, and individual RMTs working inside a listed clinic are covered by the clinic's listing. No ratings are included because we have no authorized rating source. The sync script verifies every bookingUrl responds before a listing goes live and drops entries whose URL fails.
_meta.exclusions: Excluded on purpose, with reasons, as of 2026-11-05. Closed or possibly closed: Queen Street Holistic Massage (890 Queen W; Yelp shows CLOSED, updated Sept 2026). Published prices but no confirmed online booking URL: Roncesvalles Chiropractic & Massage (264 Roncesvalles; own site says book by phone/email; 30/45/60/90 = $90/$110/$130/$180), Roncesvalles Physiotherapy (458 Roncesvalles; BOOK NOW button with no visible target; 30/45/60/90 = $70/$100/$120/$200 +HST), Nicki Iskander RMT (209 Dunn Ave, Parkdale; own rates 60/90/120 = $195/$225/$300 +HST effective Sept 2026, but no booking platform URL surfaced even in a targeted second pass - Fresha is a stale call-to-book stub; women and genderqueer new clients only; relist once her booking platform surfaces), Bellwoods Massage Therapy (Clinton & Mansfield; own-site ladder $85/$103/$120/$143/$165 +HST but no booking platform seen, address given only as an intersection, and contact details conflict). No published prices: Heal Space (1286 Dundas W; healspace.janeapp.com confirmed but two passes found no massage prices anywhere - its site prices only osteopathy; a 'Harmony Massage and Wellness' sighting at this address is a red herring, Harmony is at 350 Queen W, out of area; re-check when direct fetches work), Mackenzie Brydon RMT (194 Garden Ave; Jane page confirmed across two passes, no treatment prices captured; Sun Life shows only 'more than $125'), The Well of Alternative Medicine (1344 Queen W, Parkdale; its Jane page is confirmed - thewellness.janeapp.com location 'The Well - Parkdale' at this address - but no massage prices in any snapshot; the strongest Parkdale bench candidate, list once prices surface), Platinum Health & Wellness (955 Queen W; Jane page with RMTs, no prices), For Health's Sake (465 Queen W; 'Ask For Price', three conflicting phones), Lite Mind Body (34 Sudbury St), A Vital Touch Massage Therapy (240 Roncesvalles lower level; only children's rates seen), The Calm on Dundas (3148 Dundas W; Jane page notes an Oct 2026 fee adjustment without amounts; the only figure is from a Yelp review; two conflicting website domains), Dora Jackson RMT (home practice; sources also conflict on her address, 246 Garden Ave vs 18 Dovercourt), City RMT (2350 Dundas W; by appointment only, no prices, edge of pocket), Village Rehab Team (171 East Liberty #102; physio-led, no massage prices), TongTong Health Center and Zhen Zhen (271 and 326 Spadina; only Yelp reviewer-reported prices), Blue Sky Health Centre (421 Dundas W; ~1,200-day-old conflicting prices, no booking URL), Sutherland-Chan Clinic Spadina (742 Spadina; also out of pocket, no prices), Joe Ryan RMT (155 Lansdowne; the only published price is for mobile at-home treatments, in-studio books by phone/email, and his ClinicSense URL was only reported second-hand), Liberty Dance massage (150 East Liberty #715; phone booking only, mailing address in a residential building), and Body Mechanic/Linda Brown, Fae Rose Massage, Matthew Chu RMT (Kensington; directory-only entries ~820 days old, operation unconfirmed). Price conflicts too risky to list: Laneway Wellness (307 Roncesvalles; the tier-determining 60min price is $140 on its Noterro service page, $145 on another of its pages and $150 on Fresha, straddling the tier 3/4 line; its 30/45/90 prices are consistent, so this is the strongest bench candidate - re-check when Noterro can be fetched directly), King West Massage (725 King W; Square shows $87/$130 vs a ~2,300-day-old site page $85/$125 incl HST), Evolve Chiropractic & Physiotherapy (437 Roncesvalles #105; site says $140+HST/60 while its Jane page announces new Nov 15 2026 prices $110/$130/$155/$175 with unclear HST - re-check after Nov 15), Hand & Stone College Street (578 College; brand pages conflict on intro/member/standard pricing with no clean 60min rate and no platform URL), Myodetox Liberty Village (99 Atlantic #102; per-therapist Jane prices $145-160 conflict with site's hybrid 'Myo Session' $110/30 $185/60, plus a conflicting directory address). Address or identity conflicts: Becca Lemire RMT (Brock Ave, Parkdale; her own site withholds the street address until booking - the '222 Brock' number is Yelp/Facebook-only - and her Acuity URL was never confirmed as her site's link target; prices $99.75/$133/$199.50 +HST are otherwise usable, relist once address and booking link are confirmable), TO Kinesiology / Mettaphysica (115 Wolseley; training studio renting treatment rooms to multiple massage businesses, one not accepting new clients - identity too ambiguous, and 115 Wolseley is also Art of Mobility's former address), Shyni RMT (100A Ossington; suite number varies 13/24/113, two booking platforms, prices only on a lymphatic-drainage page), Aman Spa (one snapshot put its Jane RMTs at 100 Ossington but its own site, Facebook and Yelp all say 47 Colborne St downtown), Queen Street Remedial Massage (qsrm.setmore.com; only matching business is in Gympie, Australia), The Suite House (100 Ossington; a suite-rental building of independent practitioners, not a clinic). Not massage-core: Tight Clinic King West (628 Wellington W; aesthetics clinic, lymphatic focus, prices from its Yorkville URL path), Crafted Balance Naturopathic (1271 Dundas W #300; one RMT, no prices), Tala Beauty Bar (Sudbury St; beauty bar, aged Fresha category-page price). Covered by another listing (one listing per clinic): Kin Sze RMT practises at b-Stretched Queen West (761 Queen W). Out of the coverage pocket: The Clinic at Ossington (727 Dovercourt at Bloor; Jane shows $130/60 - good candidate if coverage expands north), Myotherapy Toronto (Bathurst/Bloor, conflicting addresses), Primal Motion (1153 Queen W #205, beyond the Queen West radius; no prices), WSB Massage & Wellness (2333 Dundas W #505), Wildflower Healing Arts (conflicting addresses, out of area), Elysium Massage Therapy (4 Prince Rupert Ave), HyperTherapy (mobile-only, no storefront), King West Centre (Richmond Hill; name collision), Parkdale Massage Therapy and Wellness (Hamilton), Align Massage Therapy Parkdale (Ottawa), Harmony U Spa (788 Dundas W; east of Bathurst), WSB Massage & Wellness also has a Jane page and a published $143-incl-HST hour - a relist candidate if coverage ever extends to Dundas West station. Mobile/home practices without storefronts were excluded throughout. Coverage note: Dundas West's one in-pocket listing (Seraphic) is on College at Brock rather than the Dundas strip itself - Heal Space is the strip's bench candidate; no listing sits in Parkdale proper (Becca Lemire and The Well are the bench), but the area pages are radius-based and the Parkdale radius captures King Liberty Health Centre and Beauty Room, as the Dundas West radius captures OCR and TOKI.
